name: footer-columns
title: Link columns footer
description: Footer with logo, tagline and social links, four link columns and a copyright bar with legal links.

standards.purpose: Close the page with navigation, legal links, and one way to reach the company.
useWhen: Every page of a marketing site.
doNotUseWhen: The surface is a modal or an embedded widget.

rules.check: Privacy, terms, and contact links are present and reachable.
The page has exactly one footer landmark.
Footer links meet AA contrast against the footer background in both themes.
